message:
The other day, as I was rummaging through my pantry, my grandkids were busy crafting their latest masterpiece—a pillow fort that could probably survive a category 5 hurricane. I had to chuckle as they declared it their ‘emergency shelter’ with all the seriousness of seasoned survivalists. It reminded me that while I was busy gathering supplies and planning for the worst, they found comfort in their little fortress, oblivious to the looming storms outside. 

I suppose there’s a lesson in that: preparedness doesn’t always have to be serious business. Sometimes, it’s about creating a sense of safety—whether it’s with supplies or a cozy fort made of couch cushions. So, what’s your family’s go-to trick for staying calm during a storm?
